text:
sophie: dropped a new variant for the notifications stack — grouping by team instead of by channel. figma: https://figma.com/file/notify-stack-grouping
manuel: nice! what's the intended collapse behavior when groups exceed width?
sophie: proposal: show first 2 groups, then a collapsed chip: "+N groups". hover/focus reveals counts per group.
leo: want to avoid ambiguous +N. can we include compact counts like "+3 (infra/eng-prod/growth)"? short but could get long. maybe abbreviate team names.
priya: abbreviations worry me for clarity. screen reader users won't get the visual abbreviation. we should expose a readable list in DOM and keep visible text short.
a11y-bot: check: collapsed chip must be keyboard focusable, with aria-haspopup="dialog" if it opens a panel, or aria-describedby pointing to a hidden list for simple tooltip. ensure the expansion target is reachable via keyboard.
manuel: what about announcements when counts change after policy edits? product wants subtle feedback so users know routing changed.
leo: use a polite live region with a short phrase: "Notification preview updated: 4 groups, primary: Infra". avoid too verbose messages.
sophie: noted. also question about visual separators between groups — thin rule vs extra spacing. thin rule looks cleaner but may be low-contrast on dark mode.
priya: thin rules often fail contrast. prefer 1px solid at 8% overlay or use spacing+subtle background to separate. test in both high-contrast and zoomed 200%.
a11y-bot: automated: validate at 200% and with forced colors. separation should not rely solely on color. provide focus outline when chip gets focus.
manuel: copy nit: current label says "collapse groups" which is action-y. maybe label the chip tooltip "Show hidden groups (3)" or the aria-label should be "Show 3 hidden notification groups".
sophie: good call. i'll set the aria-label to full sentence and keep short visible text.
leo: for the mini panel that opens on focus/hover, do we list channels inside each group? product asked to show top channel + fallback. that could be a lot of information.
priya: show primary channel name and a dimmed fallback line e.g., "Primary: PagerDuty\nFallback: email-team (if PD fails)". fallback row needs dotted border and tooltip explaining fallback semantics. ensure it's reachable by keyboard.
a11y-bot: tooltip guidance: role="tooltip" and be dismissible with Esc. if the panel is a non-modal popup, use role="dialog" with aria-modal="false" and appropriate focus management if keyboard navigable.
sophie: design actions: 1) collapsed chip visible text = "+N"; aria-label = "Show N hidden notification groups" 2) hidden panel = keyboard-focusable, lists group -> primary + fallback row 3) fallback row style = dim/dotted + tooltip + accessible description 4) add live region message on changes 5) avoid abbreviations visually and surface full names to SR users 6) check separators at 200% zoom and dark mode. i'll upload updated frames by tomorrow morning.
manuel: i'll update the product brief with the fallback visibility decision for Dedicated customers.
leo: i'll mock the focus states and keyboard flow tonight. want to pair with you, priya, on a11y testing after lunch.
priya: sounds good. small extra: add an option in settings to always expand groups by default for users who prefer full lists.
a11y-bot: suggestion: if default-expanded is user setting, persist preference in local storage and expose a control with aria-checked state. test with screen readers that the preference toggle announces its state.
sophie: thanks team. tagging @design-critique for visibility. (attached: frames + interaction gif)
